name: Mandate Authority
description: Authority evidence backed by an initial Mandate/Mandate document. On a Timeline Entry, the containing actor claims to act on behalf of actor under that mandate. The initialMandateDocument value may be materialized inline or represented as an equivalent pure { blueId: ... } reference.

actor.description: Actor on whose behalf the containing actor claims to act.

initialMandateDocument.description: Initial mandate document authorizing the represented authority relationship. A feeder or provider resolves the exact processed mandate state required for the relevant action timestamp.
